Due date: 15 May 2026
Word count: 1,480

Introduction
Guest satisfaction is widely regarded as the most important indicator of service quality in the cruise industry (Smith, 2019). This essay discusses how staff training affects satisfaction scores.

Discussion
Several studies show that trained crew resolve complaints faster (Jones et al., 2021). Cruise lines that invest in onboarding report higher repeat bookings.

Conclusion
Training is a strategic investment rather than a cost.

Bibliography
Jones, P. et al. (2021) Service recovery at sea.
Smith, R. (2019) Measuring guest satisfaction.
